trigger_conditions: a fixed-size destination predictor receives partial GPS sequences
action_steps: Proposed conditional application: Use the first five and last five known points plus learned categorical metadata embeddings as an MLP input.
verification_steps: Proposed check: Compare endpoints with full-sequence baselines under identical trip splits, define short/empty-trip handling, and assess error by prefix length.
limitations: The source omits short/empty sequence padding policy; intermediate points may matter in other routing tasks.

dimensions.current_relevance: Conditional principle; historical models and configurations require current local verification.

beginner.rationale: A compact fixed input makes a practical beginner trajectory baseline.

competitor.rationale: Informative endpoints offer a cheap alternative to sequence complexity.

practitioner.rationale: Endpoint summarization may reduce serving cost when prefix-length and geographic drift are validated.

title: Separate stopping selection from final performance estimation
trigger_conditions: early stopping chooses an epoch using labeled validation
action_steps: Proposed conditional application: Use training, stopping-validation and separate performance-holdout partitions, or a fixed fold-robust epoch count.
verification_steps: Proposed check: Reserve final untouched scoring partition after choosing epochs; compare selection score with independent estimate.
limitations: Three-way splits reduce training/scoring sample sizes; early stopping itself is legitimate.

dimensions.current_relevance: Conditional principle; historical models and configurations require current local verification.

beginner.rationale: Specific bias-control procedure with modest split effort.

competitor.rationale: High value honest performance estimation.

practitioner.rationale: Broad independent final evaluation discipline.

title: Fuse boxes across detector scales
trigger_conditions: multiple detectors produce competing boxes for the same objects
action_steps: Proposed conditional application: Use weighted box fusion to combine multi-scale detector predictions and compare it with the existing suppression/ensemble baseline.
verification_steps: Proposed check: Compare WBF and NMS with identical detectors on source-held-out AP; check class mapping and coordinate rescaling.
limitations: Correlated detectors can reinforce errors; nine-model inference is expensive.

dimensions.current_relevance: Conditional principle; historical models and configurations require current local verification.

beginner.rationale: Multiple detectors make reproduction costly.

competitor.rationale: Clear multi-scale localization fusion option.

practitioner.rationale: Conditional detection improvement with high serving cost.

title: Group metadata classification by article
trigger_conditions: multiple dataset mentions belong to one scientific article
action_steps: Proposed conditional application: Validate primary/secondary DOI classification with article-grouped folds, using dataset/article title and author similarities.
verification_steps: Proposed check: Audit article isolation across folds and report type-only and end-to-end mention/type scores separately.
limitations: The 0.87 type score conditions on 302 true-positive mentions; it cannot be compared directly to end-to-end 0.82 as a method gain.

dimensions.current_relevance: Conditional principle; historical models and configurations require current local verification.

beginner.rationale: Article grouping teaches a clear repeated-entity leakage rule.

competitor.rationale: Grouped validation and denominator accounting improve model selection for mention tasks.

practitioner.rationale: Document-level isolation and end-to-end accounting are broadly useful evaluation practices.

sources.title: Make Data Count — Finding Data References (2025)

title: Bound correction from a second localization pass
trigger_conditions: a refinement model may return invalid or unstable event times
action_steps: Proposed: validate the refined timestamp and blend a clipped time correction into the coarse estimate.
verification_steps: Proposed: measure correction error against coarse estimates and stratify invalid outputs and large shifts.
limitations: Clipping can suppress a legitimate large correction; the source provides no isolated effectiveness measurement.

dimensions.current_relevance: Conditional technique; verify current tooling and data assumptions.

beginner.rationale: Range and shift guards are concrete, although evaluating event-localization quality requires labeled clips.

competitor.rationale: Adds a low-cost robustness comparison after an existing coarse/refine pipeline.

practitioner.rationale: Guarding model-proposed corrections transfers to bounded numeric refinement; choose bounds from application error costs.

title: Test gradient accumulation rather than assuming equivalence
trigger_conditions: large detection models motivate smaller micro-batches
action_steps: Proposed conditional application: Verify accumulation behavior against actual-batch training before adopting it.
verification_steps: Proposed check: Match effective batch, optimizer steps and LR; compare actual/accumulated batches with normalization behavior controlled.
limitations: Microbatch statistics, loss scaling or implementation may differ; failure is local.

dimensions.current_relevance: Conditional principle; historical models and configurations require current local verification.

beginner.rationale: Useful warning requiring training-loop knowledge.

competitor.rationale: Prevents assuming accumulated batches are equivalent.

practitioner.rationale: General memory-workaround verification habit.

title: Audit near-deterministic price formulas for target availability
trigger_conditions: input fields may encode a near-deterministic version of the target
action_steps: Proposed adaptation of source observation: Verify field definitions and prediction-time availability before comparing a formula baseline with learned regression.
verification_steps: Proposed verification: Check formulas by parking condition and test whether unit price itself derives from the target.
limitations: Very high explanatory power can reflect leakage; the conditional formula and factor five are dataset-specific and not verified physical laws.

dimensions.current_relevance: Transferable decision; verify suitability and current tooling in the target setting.

beginner.rationale: Target-definition audit accessible and guards spectacular misleading gains.

competitor.rationale: High value identifying algebraic target information before claiming prediction.

practitioner.rationale: Broad leakage diagnosis; sourceformula cannot establish deployable forecasting.

title: Check alignment before averaging saved arrays
trigger_conditions: prediction files carry arrays without embedded example IDs
action_steps: Proposed: verify identical row and class order before averaging stored predictions.
verification_steps: Proposed: store and compare row IDs, class vocabulary and shapes for every component before averaging.
limitations: Alignment checks are proposed; the script itself only averages arrays.

dimensions.current_relevance: Conditional technique; verify current tooling and data assumptions.

beginner.rationale: A cheap, concrete array-versus-ID lesson avoids silent ensemble corruption.

competitor.rationale: Essential for saved class-probability libraries from independent scripts.

practitioner.rationale: Broad batch inference contract: compare both entity and class axes before model fusion.

title: Choose ensemble components separately for distinct output types
trigger_conditions: a multimodal model predicts time, location and event class
action_steps: Proposed recipe: test output-specific blending instead of applying one rule to every output.
verification_steps: Proposed check: Ablate output-specific versus uniform blends using held-out videos, evaluate each output and composite score, and audit label/coordinate alignment.
limitations: Two large VLMs have high compute requirements;9:1and single-model type choice are tuned source settings.

dimensions.current_relevance: Reusable decision; historical configurations and resource access require current local verification.

beginner.rationale: Output-specific fusion is understandable but very large models reduce feasibility.

competitor.rationale: Separate output reliability offers a focused ensemble experiment.

practitioner.rationale: Multi-output systems can use per-output fusion if utility, availability and cost justify it.

title: Downweight low-information pseudo-labeled soundscapes
trigger_conditions: pseudo-label confidence varies among long audio samples
action_steps: Proposed conditional application: Weight soundscape sampling by the sum of maximum label probabilities, then train on random twenty-second intervals.
verification_steps: Proposed check: Compare weighted and uniform sampling at equal steps; audit pseudo-label correctness and rare/no-call coverage.
limitations: Probability sum also measures call density and can suppress rare quiet recordings.

dimensions.current_relevance: Conditional principle; historical models and configurations require current local verification.

beginner.rationale: Confidence sampling needs pseudo-label pipeline skills.

competitor.rationale: Specific remedy for nearly unlabeled soundscapes.

practitioner.rationale: Useful only when confidence proxy correlates with label quality.

title: Evaluate a blend of independent solution pipelines
trigger_conditions: Two solution pipelines target the same regression outputs.
action_steps: Proposed conditional application: Preserve the component identities; the source used0.6AutoGluon and0.4public solution.
Proposed conditional application: Treat those weights as a competition example rather than defaults.
verification_steps: Proposed check: Generate aligned out-of-fold component predictions, select weights on inner validation, and compare blend with both components on untouched measurements.
limitations: Source's0.6/0.4are examples; pipeline complementarity and isolated gain are not demonstrated.

dimensions.current_relevance: Processing principle remains testable; implementation and validation require local checks.

beginner.rationale: A weighted blend is straightforward when component predictions are aligned.

competitor.rationale: Preserving actual components makes a reusable ensemble test rather than a generic recipe.

practitioner.rationale: Independent pipelines can complement each other if gain justifies maintenance cost.

title: Keep logit blending distinct from probability averaging
trigger_conditions: several image classifiers produce comparable logits
action_steps: Proposed recipe: compare a weighted logit sum followed by softmax with individual predictions.
verification_steps: Proposed check: Compare logit and probability blending using identical out-of-fold scores, calibrate scales, and evaluate macroF1and serving cost.
limitations: Logit scales vary by backbone and calibration; weights can overfit reused validation.

dimensions.current_relevance: Reusable decision; historical configurations and resource access require current local verification.

beginner.rationale: The order of softmax and averaging is a useful teachable distinction.

competitor.rationale: A precise blending ablation helps assess scale and diversity.

practitioner.rationale: Score fusion needs calibration and untouched assessment regardless of model family.

title: Accumulate OOF and test predictions with different denominators
trigger_conditions: multi-seed K-fold bagging produces one holdout prediction per seed and K test predictions per seed
action_steps: Proposed: write holdout predictions at their original indices and normalize OOF by seeds but test by folds times seeds.
verification_steps: Proposed: assert each training row is predicted once per seed and every component shares class order; evaluate grouped spatial folds if neighboring points are dependent.
limitations: ExtraTrees median imputation is fitted before folds, and random point stratification may not match spatial generalization. Source comments claiming usually better are not measured results.

dimensions.current_relevance: Conditional technique; verify current tooling and data assumptions.

beginner.rationale: Beginner can follow denominator arithmetic but multi-model multi-seed training is costly.

competitor.rationale: Competitor gains immediately useful OOF versus test accounting and independent checks against silent scaling errors.

practitioner.rationale: Practitioner can audit bagged predictions broadly; spatial dependence and fold-local transforms require extra work.

title: Keep per-model training and inference configuration together
trigger_conditions: many architecture and hyperparameter configurations are being tested
action_steps: Proposed recipe: store model-specific YAML configurations and track training and validation measurements.
verification_steps: Proposed check: Bind config and metric logs to code/data hashes and checkpoints and regenerate one model's inference outputs from its saved configuration.
limitations: Configuration files alone omit mutable data and dependencies unless versioned; source supplies no verified replay.

dimensions.current_relevance: Reusable decision; historical configurations and resource access require current local verification.

beginner.rationale: Storing model settings and metrics is easy and prevents lost experiments.

competitor.rationale: Tracked configurations support comparison across many backbone trials.

practitioner.rationale: Reproducible lineage transfers to maintenance, retraining and deployment audits.
